question: What supreme attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment
This accomplishment is called great accomplishment
One possessing it may become dear to the yoginis
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes the practitioner dear to the yoginis
plain_english: One may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
